messages:
katy: Quick async — Pioneer offline-gateway private rollout status check. TL;DR: network tests mostly green, HSM key import and egress-fallback consent are outstanding. tagging owners for confirmations.

Darren: Verified NAT rules + firewall PR merged to staging. PR ran smoke: `nc -vz 10.0.0.1 443` => succeeded. Staging load looks stable.

minh: HSM/KMS team update — we need the customer's CSR and KMS ARN to import keys. ETA EOD tomorrow if they send it today. Also, our cert-rotate tool lacks an `--offline` flag (see issue).

yara: I pinged the account lead and customer contact. Customer says they prefer USB courier for key material (airgap). Asked for courier ETA.

katy: Noted — adding airgap import runbook to checklist (item 6). Also: are we contractually allowed to fallback to public region if private egress fails? @darren to confirm.

Darren: Contractually allowed for high-severity failover with customer consent; legal ok with encrypted tokens but want sec signoff. cc @sasha-security.

sasha-security: Security note: prod requires HSM-backed keys. Fallback to regional hosted model only with explicit consent and logging enabled. Need signed consent doc uploaded to the ticket.

minh: Blocker: cert rotation CLI missing `--offline` mode. Filed issue #789 and a short-term manual workaround exists (openssl steps). Will post commands.

ops-bot: snapshot: staging-egress-checks at 12:03 UTC — 42/44 tests passed. Failures: DNS resolution for two internal hostnames (customer side).

yara: Customer sent hosts list via SFTP earlier; I asked them to re-export as CSV and S3 share. Waiting on that.

Darren: Proposed next steps (owners):
1) CSR + KMS ARN — owner: yara
2) Customer signed fallback consent — owner: sasha-security
3) Runbook + airgap import checklist signoff — owner: katy/ops
4) Manual cert rotation (short-term) — owner: minh
5) Smoke cutover window Tue 10:00-12:00 PT — owner: darren

katy: I'm updating the rollout spreadsheet and will add these as action items. If we agree, I'll mark network as "ready pending keys/consent". :thumbsup:

minh: Working on the manual cert rotate doc now. Quick excerpt (will verify in staging first):
```
# manual cert import (airgap)
openssl genrsa -out client.key 4096
openssl req -new -key client.key -out client.csr -subj "/CN=pioneer-gateway"
# Customer will sign CSR offline and return cert.pem
# Import steps (on offline host):
scp cert.pem /etc/ssl/pioneer/
chmod 640 /etc/ssl/pioneer/*
systemctl restart redwood-gateway
```
I'll paste the full runbook when ready.

yara: Update: customer confirmed Tue window and said they'll courier USB token per our SOP. Provided contact: jordan@pioneer.com — I shared that with support.

Darren: Small infra PR to add `--offline` flag landed to canary: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/415 — canary tests green.

katy: Great. If no objections, I'll close the blockers doc EOD and put this at top of tomorrow standup. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging -> canary: infra/pr-415 succeeded (12:18 UTC)
